note: 18 of the chart's 20 angles. Left out #16 Tilt Up and #17 Tilt Down: they are moves, already covered by 'Tilt' in camera-moves.json. 'chart_no' is the number in the image.

items.name: Eye level
items.description: Camera at eye level. Natural and balanced.

items.name: High angle
items.description: Camera above the subject; makes them look smaller.
items.prompt: high angle shot looking down, subject appears small

items.name: Low angle
items.description: Camera below the subject; makes them look strong.
items.prompt: low angle shot looking up, subject looks powerful

items.name: Bird's eye view
items.description: Straight down from above; shows the whole scene.
items.prompt: bird's eye view, straight down overhead shot

items.name: Dutch angle
items.description: Tilted camera; adds energy, drama and unease.

items.name: Close up
items.description: Close to the face; shows detail and emotion.
items.prompt: close-up shot, face fills the frame, emotional detail

items.name: Wide shot
items.description: More background included; shows place and space.
items.prompt: wide shot, subject within the environment

items.name: Long shot
items.description: Full body in frame; shows subject and scene.
items.prompt: long shot, full body visible in the scene

items.name: POV shot
items.description: Shot from the subject's point of view.
items.prompt: POV shot from the character's eyes, first person

items.name: Top down
items.description: Shot from above at a steep angle.

items.name: Side angle
items.description: Shot from the side; adds shape and depth.
items.prompt: side angle profile shot, shape and depth

items.name: Back view
items.prompt: back view, subject seen from behind

items.name: Framed shot
items.description: Uses something in the scene to frame the subject.
items.prompt: framed shot through a doorway or arch, natural frame around subject

items.name: Symmetrical shot
items.prompt: symmetrical composition, centred subject, balanced both sides

items.name: OTS close
items.description: Close over-the-shoulder; more focus on the face.
items.prompt: tight over-the-shoulder shot, focus on the face

items.name: Leading lines
items.description: Uses lines to lead the eye to the subject.
items.prompt: leading lines draw the eye to the subject, path or railing converging

items.name: Extreme low angle
items.description: Camera very low; makes the subject look epic.
items.prompt: extreme low angle, camera at ground level, epic towering subject
